alt: a large open kitchen with a long island, viewed from inside the space, with stained glass pendant lights above the island catching warm winter sun, a still alpine lake reflected in the glazing beyond.
text:
stained glass catches the four o'clock sun and breaks it into the kitchen below. the light stripes everything it crosses. the glass only matters because of what it does to the moment.
